title: Surreal Mosaic Eye Face
description: A large central human eye with an intricate mechanical iris containing a black 'L' symbol, embedded in a fragmented face composed of colorful mosaic tiles, circuit boards, and painted textures. The face is surrounded by multiple floating eyeballs on tentacle-like organic-mechanical appendages against a swirling, smoky golden-brown background.
